**Per diem (retention daily accrual)** = basis × (note + MIP)/100/365, round last.
- Rate: 6.875 + 0.5 (MIP of payout plan: HECM product docs not yet published; 0.5 read from the HECM ledger `hecm_mip_accrual rate_applied_pct 0.5` — **conditional** on the hecm KB carrying 0.5 for HECM Line of Credit). Day count 365 (statement timing schedule).
- Basis = 414281.18 + set-aside disbursement carry 5720.40 + preservation advance carry 405.00 + due-and-payable appraisal carry 550.00 + replacement appraisal carry 395.00 + foreclosure charge carry 875.00 = 422226.58.
  - Set-aside carry: FF LESA (Mandatory) → bills limited to balance. Lead days 15 tax / 30 insurance (setaside "Charges Paid, Payees and Payment Lead Times by Plan"). Horizon statement date 2026-10-14 + 30 = 2026-11-13. Tax 2612.40 due 11-12 → pays 10-28 ✓; hazard 1968.00 due 11-20 → 10-21 ✓; flood 1140.00 due 12-08 → 11-08 ✓. Sum 5720.40 ≤ 6950.00.
  - Preservation: latest inspection 2026-09-29 `vacant`; Principal Residence Change "Vacant property may be secured: yes"; FHA condo → 285.00 + 120.00.
  - D&P appraisal carry: FHA condo → 550.00.
  - Replacement: latest granted extension entry effective 2026-06-10; appraisal 2026-09-30 is >30 days (plan's appraisal order days 30) after it → first span fails; >30 days after D&P 2025-12-21 → 395.00.
  - Foreclosure carry: referred 2026-09-20, 24 days before statement date → 875.00.
- **Per diem = 85.31.**

**Statement** (statement date = today 2026-10-14). Window: referred to foreclosure → 15 days → **good-through 2026-10-29**. Balance = principal + per diem × (days since latest posted interest accrual 2026-10-01 → 13, + window 15 = 28 → 2388.68) + tax 2612.40 (≤6950) + hazard 1968.00 (≤6950−2612.40) + flood 1140.00 (≤2369.60) + servicing fee 35.00 (monthly_adjustable × fee months: latest posted fee period 2026-09 → 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-14 = 1; monthly-adjustable fee of payout plan read as 35.00 from the ledger's `hecm_servicing_fee` — **conditional** on the hecm KB) + maintenance 120.00 (vacant FHA condo, flat) = **422545.26**.

**Approval**: appraised value basis **640000.00**; cap 95% = 608000.00. Retention balance figure = 422545.26 + called-due appraisal 550.00 (condo) + replacement appraisal 395.00 + foreclosure charge 875.00 (24 days before approval date) + property securing 285.00 (vacant, securing permitted) + notice postage 35.40 (4 notice-sent entries: D&P notice, options letter, extension letter, foreclosure referral notice) − prompt-decision credit 375.00 (accepted retain_property declaration 2026-01-12 ≤ response deadline 2026-01-20; 1 granted extension entry) = 424310.66. Lesser → **required payoff amount 424310.66**.

**Retention remittance** = shortfall (424310.66 − net held 180750.00 [receipts 150000+1500+25000+1000+5000+2500+750 − return 5000] = 243560.66) + clearing cushion 426.55 (referred → 85.31 × 5) + wire receipt fee 30.00 (4 wire receipts incl. recalled) + returned remittance fee 25.00 (returned wire, no returned cashier's check) + release title search fee 95.00 (closing 2016-04-28 → 2026-10-14 = 125 whole months) + release recording charge 96.00 (HECM, profile not Living Trust → 2 instruments) = **244233.21**.
